Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability for users to access video logs for unattended desktop flow runs directly from the portal, improving troubleshooting without needing local machine access in Power Automate. This feature will reach public preview on September 15, 2026.

How does this affect me?
Video logs captured during unattended desktop flow runs are now stored in Dataverse and surfaced directly in the flow run details page in the Power Automate portal.

When a run fails, users can access the recorded video immediately from the run details experience, without needing to retrieve files from the local machine. These videos provide visual context of the last moments before failure, helping identify issues such as UI interaction failures, timing problems, or unexpected system prompts.

This builds on the existing video logging capability for unattended runs and extends it by enabling centralized storage and access through the portal, improving visibility and usability across environments and teams.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

Title: Microsoft Power Automate - View unattended run video logs in portal
